title: FMT$^{\mathrm{X}}$: Lazy Wavefront Search for Dynamic Replanning
abstract: arXiv:2509.08521v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: FMT$^{*}$ plans efficiently in static worlds by expanding a cost-ordered wavefront and collision-checking lazily, but its single-pass unvisited rule cannot revise paths when obstacles change. We present FMT$^{\mathrm{X}}$, an anytime, asymptotically optimal generalization of that wavefront for dynamic replanning. A cost-improvement test replaces the unvisited set, allowing a node to be revisited for best-parent selection whenever a lower-cost potential connection is found. This induces implicit rewiring within the wavefront while preserving lazy collision checking. FMT$^{\mathrm{X}}$ retains the online densification of RRT$^{*}$ but defers its eager neighborhood rewiring to the cost-ordered wavefront, so a node is revisited only when the expansion reaches it. Obstacle updates orphan the affected subtree and reseed the wavefront. A direct cost push from each parent to its children propagates cost improvements through validated t

translated_title: FMT$^{\mathrm{X}}$：用于动态重规划的惰性波前搜索
translated_abstract: arXiv:2509.08521v2 公告类型：替换-交叉 摘要：FMT$^{*}$通过在静态环境中扩展成本有序波前并进行惰性碰撞检查来实现高效规划，但其单次遍历的未访问规则在障碍物变化时无法修正路径。我们提出了FMT$^{\mathrm{X}}$，这是该波前用于动态重规划的任意时间、渐近最优的推广。一个成本改进测试替代了未访问集合，允许节点在发现更低成本的潜在连接时被重新访问以进行最佳父节点选择。这在波前内实现了隐式重连，同时保留了惰性碰撞检查。FMT$^{\mathrm{X}}$保留了RRT$^{*}$的在线加密特性，但将其急切邻域重连推迟到成本有序波前，因此节点仅在扩展到达时才被重新访问。障碍物更新会使受影响的子树孤立并重新播种波前。从每个父节点到其子节点的直接成本推送通过已验证的路径传播成本改进。
tldr: FMT$^{\mathrm{X}}$通过成本改进测试替代未访问规则，实现动态环境下的惰性波前重规划，支持任意时间和渐近最优的隐式重连。
en_tdlr: FMT$^{\mathrm{X}}$ replaces the unvisited rule with a cost-improvement test, enabling lazy wavefront replanning in dynamic environments with anytime and asymptotically optimal implicit rewiring.
